desc: Add resolver-backed INITIAL_PLANNING routing data and rendering behavior so entry-points expose a specialized simple target plus an optional mapped master fan-out target, explicit entry-point rendering consumes the same data as classification rendering, and missing master mappings fall back to one specialized planning task.
done_when: INITIAL_PLANNING wake data exposes, for each configured entry-point, the specialized simple target role-pair/task-type/display-name/task-ID-prefix and the resolver-mapped master fan-out target role-pair/task-type/display-name/task-ID-prefix when one exists; explicit `Goal.EntryPoint` rendering uses the same resolved entry-point data as the classification list; simple-goal task examples target the specialized role-pair and fan-out task examples target the mapped master role-pair; when no mapped master exists, rendering falls back to exactly one specialized planning task and does not invent a master role-pair; resolver errors while building wake data surface as render errors; focused prompt tests cover explicit `general-objective`, `functional-spec`, `detailed-spec`, and `technical-spec` routes, classification data, mapped master targets, and missing-master fallback; `go test ./internal/prompts/...` passes.
scope: internal/prompts/wake.go, internal/prompts/templates/wake_initial_planning.tmpl, internal/prompts/builder_test.go, and focused prompt helper tests needed to prove route-data construction. Consume the decomposition-root resolver lookup planned by `architecture-1`; do not modify pipeline YAML/schema/validation, resolver topology implementation beyond API consumption, master prompt sections, output-entry manifest validation, artifact propagation, docs, ADRs, broad end-to-end scenario tests, or unrelated prompt prose.
